name: National Gallery of Armenia
about: Armenia's main art museum, on Republic Square. Armenian, Russian and European art from medieval times to today, plus changing exhibitions.

name: Cafesjian Center for the Arts
about: Contemporary art museum in and around the Cascade, the giant stairway at the top of Tamanyan Street. Sculpture garden outside, galleries inside the steps.

name: Contemporary Art Centre (HayArt)
about: Yerevan's municipal centre for contemporary art, on Mashtots Avenue.

name: Modern Art Museum of Yerevan
about: Armenian art from the 1960s on, in one of the first museums of modern art in the Soviet Union.

name: Armenian Center for Contemporary Experimental Art
about: ACCEA: experimental art, performance, sound and video since the 1990s.

name: Museum of Russian Art
about: Russian paintings and drawings from the collection of Aram Abrahamyan.

name: Martiros Saryan House-Museum
about: The house and studio of the painter Martiros Saryan, with a large collection of his work.

name: Hovhannes Tumanyan Museum
about: Museum of the poet Hovhannes Tumanyan: his life, books and manuscripts.

name: Folk Art Museum of Armenia
about: Armenian folk and decorative art: carpets, wood carving, lace, embroidery and ceramics.

name: Sergei Parajanov Museum
about: The filmmaker and artist Sergei Parajanov's collages, drawings and assemblages, in a house above the Hrazdan gorge.

name: ArAr Gallery
about: Gallery in a historic wine cellar on Pushkin Street, with music, wine and film nights.

name: A1 Art Space
about: Art space and café at the start of Abovyan Street, with talks and small shows.

name: Arno Babajanyan Concert Hall (Philharmonia)
about: Home of the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra. Its foyers host small exhibitions.

name: Union of Architects
about: Exhibition hall of the Union of Architects of Armenia on Baghramyan Avenue.

name: Machar
about: Wine bar that hangs art shows you can buy from.

name: Pyunik Development Centre
about: Community centre that hosts exhibitions and sales.

name: Forty44
about: Bar on Parpetsi Street that hosts art openings.

name: Rambalkoshe Dilijan
about: A house turned into a museum and art space in Dilijan, with a park and a tandoor bakery.
